name: B10-0315/2026 (Renew) – Political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Nicaragua – the cases of Carlos Brenes, Salvadora del Socorro Martínez Aburto and Brooklyn Rivera
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position and making demands. It calls on Nicaragua's government to release people held arbitrarily, including Carlos Brenes and his wife Salvadora Martínez, and to prove they are alive. It condemns the death in custody of Brooklyn Rivera and asks for an investigation. It also asks the European Union to use its trade agreement with Central America and its sanctions list against Nicaragua's leaders.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are demands, not decisions.
- **Who it affects:** Nicaragua's government and its prisoners, including the three named.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the EU Council, Commission and others; no action is guaranteed.
